name: Remix Remix Global Hospital Information System (HIS) Staff Portal v2
description: Comprehensive Enterprise Hospital Information System (HIS) with Staff Portals for OPD Clinics, Emergency (ER), Inpatient Wards (IPD/ADT), Intensive Care (ICU), Operating Rooms (OR), Laboratory (LIS), Radiology (RIS), Pharmacy Operations, Blood Bank & Transfusion Medicine, Enterprise Materials Management & Supply Chain Operations UX, Healthcare Procurement & Purchasing Operations UX, Healthcare Finance & Accounts Payable (AP) Operations UX, General Ledger & Chart of Accounts (GL/COA) Core, Hospital Treasury & Cash/Bank Operations UX, Patient Accounts Receivable & Revenue Cycle Operations UX, and CSSD & Sterile Processing Operations UX featuring Point-of-Use Return, Contaminated Transport Receipt & Count Reconciliation, Ultrasonic & Washer-Disinfector Cleaning (A0 >= 3000), Microscopic Inspection & Soil Checks, Set Assembly & Master Recipe Verification, Packaging & Class 5 Chemical Integrator Placement, Sterilizer Chamber Loads & Bowie-Dick Verification, Tri-Pillar Clinical Release Authority (Mechanical, Chemical, Biological), Event-Related Sterile Storage & Surgical Case Dispatch, End-to-End Medical Device UDI Traceability, and Infection Prevention & Recall Protocols.
